what: Accent-color vertical lines line up behind the panel (default 55 lines, tall to the top at the edges · lower toward the center), each line holding two or three thick nodes. When the cursor comes within 140px, the nearest node grabs the end opposite the cursor and flattens down to .4x — force is 1−(1−t)³, following is 1−e^(−8·dt) per frame. The blurred glow blob behind the panel is pushed up to 110px away from the cursor within 280px and follows with e^(−6·dt)

options.push: Light blob push (px), default 110 · reach distance 280

note: The element is laid as a background pattern filling its parent (absolute · inset 0 · z-index 0) and draws the SVG itself. The original found convex stretches (nodes) inside the line path and moved the points, but here the nodes are separately drawn bars pressed down with scaleY. On touch devices (no hover) nothing is pressed and only the drawing stays
